holdoutPredicates.S1: missing close/surviving group: <=3000 virtual ms, explicit uncertainty, no next row; signal is not close
holdoutPredicates.S2: post-final persistence drift of supervisor/config/auth/SEAL/explicit external ADMITTED and added entries refuses; provisional is not success
holdoutPredicates.S3: registered planned before mkdir, acquired before failing stat; no guessed destructive cleanup
holdoutPredicates.S4: spawn/row/final receipt failures retain actual adapter launch/close accounting and exact thrown object
holdoutPredicates.S5: synchronous throw/no-PID error cannot invent spawn/close; actual driver's listener wiring recorded
holdoutPredicates.order: close or exit preceding spawn must not become successful solely because group absence is delayed
holdoutPredicates.late: error between exit and close faults; errors after terminal close/final persistence do not mutate completed report or escape listeners (declared terminal policy)
holdoutPredicates.data: actual VM values: exact own keys/types/sequence, no prototype equality, holes/accessors/symbols/extras/coercion refused; host thrown reference survives
